absorb.name: Absorb
absorb.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

accelerock.name: Accelerock
accelerock.effect: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

acid.name: Acid
acid.effect: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

acidArmor.name: Acid Armor
acidArmor.effect: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

acidDownpourPhysical.name: Acid Downpour
acidDownpourPhysical.effect: The user creates a poisonous swamp using its Z-Power and sinks the target into it at full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

acidSpray.name: Acid Spray
acidSpray.effect: The user spits fluid that works to melt the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.effect: The user nimbly strikes the target. The fewer held items, the higher the damage it inflicts.

acupressure.name: Acupressure
acupressure.effect: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.

aerialAce.name: Aerial Ace
aerialAce.effect: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

aeroblast.name: Aeroblast
aeroblast.effect: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

afterYou.name: After You
afterYou.effect: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.

agility.name: Agility
agility.effect: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

airCutter.name: Air Cutter
airCutter.effect: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

airSlash.name: Air Slash
airSlash.effect: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.

allOutPummelingPhysical.name: All-Out Pummeling
allOutPummelingPhysical.effect: The user rams an energy orb created by its Z-Power into the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

alluringVoice.name: Alluring Voice
alluringVoice.effect: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.

allySwitch.name: Ally Switch
allySwitch.effect: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies.

amnesia.name: Amnesia
amnesia.effect: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

anchorShot.name: Anchor Shot
anchorShot.effect: The user entangles the target with its anchor chain while attacking. The target becomes unable to flee.

ancientPower.name: Ancient Power
ancientPower.effect: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user's stats at once.

appleAcid.name: Apple Acid
appleAcid.effect: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

aquaCutter.name: Aqua Cutter
aquaCutter.effect: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

aquaJet.name: Aqua Jet
aquaJet.effect: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

aquaRing.name: Aqua Ring
aquaRing.effect: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.

aquaStep.name: Aqua Step
aquaStep.effect: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.

aquaTail.name: Aqua Tail
aquaTail.effect: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

armThrust.name: Arm Thrust
armThrust.effect: The user lets loose a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

armorCannon.name: Armor Cannon
armorCannon.effect: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

aromatherapy.name: Aromatherapy
aromatherapy.effect: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status conditions affecting the user's party.

aromaticMist.name: Aromatic Mist
aromaticMist.effect: The user raises the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.

assist.name: Assist
assist.effect: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.

assurance.name: Assurance
assurance.effect: If the target has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack's power is doubled.

astonish.name: Astonish
astonish.effect: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

astralBarrage.name: Astral Barrage
astralBarrage.effect: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

attackOrder.name: Attack Order
attackOrder.effect: The user calls out its underlings to pummel the target. Critical hits land more easily.

attract.name: Attract
attract.effect: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

auraSphere.name: Aura Sphere
auraSphere.effect: The user lets loose a blast of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.

auraWheel.name: Aura Wheel
auraWheel.effect: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

auroraBeam.name: Aurora Beam
auroraBeam.effect: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

auroraVeil.name: Aurora Veil
auroraVeil.effect: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.

autotomize.name: Autotomize
autotomize.effect: The user sheds part of its body to make itself lighter and sharply raise its Speed stat.

avalanche.name: Avalanche
avalanche.effect: The power of this attack move is doubled if the user has been hurt by the target in the same turn.

axeKick.name: Axe Kick
axeKick.effect: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.

babyDollEyes.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
babyDollEyes.effect: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.

baddyBad.name: Baddy Bad
baddyBad.effect: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon's physical moves.

banefulBunker.name: Baneful Bunker
banefulBunker.effect: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.

barbBarrage.name: Barb Barrage
barbBarrage.effect: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move's power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.

barrage.name: Barrage
barrage.effect: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.effect: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

batonPass.name: Baton Pass
batonPass.effect: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

beakBlast.name: Beak Blast
beakBlast.effect: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the Pokémon while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.

beatUp.name: Beat Up
beatUp.effect: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

behemothBash.name: Behemoth Bash
behemothBash.effect: The user's body becomes a firm shield and slams into the target fiercely.

behemothBlade.name: Behemoth Blade
behemothBlade.effect: The user wields a large, powerful sword using its whole body and cuts the target in a vigorous attack.

belch.name: Belch
belch.effect: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.

bellyDrum.name: Belly Drum
bellyDrum.effect: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

bestow.name: Bestow
bestow.effect: The user passes its held item to the target when the target isn't holding an item.

bide.name: Bide
bide.effect: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

bind.name: Bind
bind.effect: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

bite.name: Bite
bite.effect: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

bitterBlade.name: Bitter Blade
bitterBlade.effect: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

bitterMalice.name: Bitter Malice
bitterMalice.effect: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

blackHoleEclipsePhysical.name: Black Hole Eclipse
blackHoleEclipsePhysical.effect: The user gathers dark energy using its Z-Power and sucks the target into it. The power varies, depending on the original move.

blastBurn.name: Blast Burn
blastBurn.effect: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.

blazeKick.name: Blaze Kick
blazeKick.effect: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

blazingTorque.name: Blazing Torque
blazingTorque.effect: The user revs their blazing engine into the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

bleakwindStorm.name: Bleakwind Storm
bleakwindStorm.effect: The user attacks with savagely cold winds that cause both body and spirit to tremble. This may also lower the Speed stats of opposing Pokémon.

blizzard.name: Blizzard
blizzard.effect: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

block.name: Block
block.effect: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent escape.

bloodMoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodMoon.effect: The user unleashes the full brunt of its spirit from a full moon that shines as red as blood. This move can't be used twice in a row.

bloomDoomPhysical.name: Bloom Doom
bloomDoomPhysical.effect: The user collects energy from plants using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

blueFlare.name: Blue Flare
blueFlare.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense, yet beautiful, blue flame. This may also leave the target with a burn.

bodyPress.name: Body Press
bodyPress.effect: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

bodySlam.name: Body Slam
bodySlam.effect: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

boltBeak.name: Bolt Beak
boltBeak.effect: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

boltStrike.name: Bolt Strike
boltStrike.effect: The user surrounds itself with a great amount of electricity and charges its target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

boneClub.name: Bone Club
boneClub.effect: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.

boneRush.name: Bone Rush
boneRush.effect: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

bonemerang.name: Bonemerang
bonemerang.effect: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

boomburst.name: Boomburst
boomburst.effect: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible, explosive sound.

bounce.name: Bounce
bounce.effect: The user bounces up high, then drops on the target on the second turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

bouncyBubble.name: Bouncy Bubble
bouncyBubble.effect: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by the damage taken by the target.

branchPoke.name: Branch Poke
branchPoke.effect: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

braveBird.name: Brave Bird
braveBird.effect: The user tucks in its wings and charges from a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.

breakingSwipe.name: Breaking Swipe
breakingSwipe.effect: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

breakneckBlitzPhysical.name: Breakneck Blitz
breakneckBlitzPhysical.effect: The user builds up its momentum using its Z-Power and crashes into the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

brickBreak.name: Brick Break
brickBreak.effect: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

brine.name: Brine
brine.effect: If the target's HP is half or less, this attack will hit with double the power.

brutalSwing.name: Brutal Swing
brutalSwing.effect: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

bubble.name: Bubble
bubble.effect: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.

bubbleBeam.name: Bubble Beam
bubbleBeam.effect: A spray of bubbles is forcefully ejected at the target. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

bugBite.name: Bug Bite
bugBite.effect: The user bites the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

bugBuzz.name: Bug Buzz
bugBuzz.effect: The user generates a damaging sound wave by vibration. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

bulkUp.name: Bulk Up
bulkUp.effect: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, raising both its Attack and Defense stats.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.effect: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.

bulletPunch.name: Bullet Punch
bulletPunch.effect: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

bulletSeed.name: Bullet Seed
bulletSeed.effect: The user forcefully shoots seeds at the target two to five times in a row.

burnUp.name: Burn Up
burnUp.effect: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.

burningBulwark.name: Burning Bulwark
burningBulwark.effect: The user's intensely hot fur protects it from attacks and also burns any attacker that makes direct contact with it.

burningJealousy.name: Burning Jealousy
burningJealousy.effect: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

buzzyBuzz.name: Buzzy Buzz
buzzyBuzz.effect: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

calmMind.name: Calm Mind
calmMind.effect: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to raise its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

camouflage.name: Camouflage
camouflage.effect: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

captivate.name: Captivate
captivate.effect: If any opposing Pokémon is the opposite gender of the user, it is charmed, which harshly lowers its Sp. Atk stat.

catastropika.name: Catastropika
catastropika.effect: The user, Pikachu, surrounds itself with the maximum amount of electricity using its Z-Power and pounces on its target with full force.

ceaselessEdge.name: Ceaseless Edge
ceaselessEdge.effect: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.

celebrate.name: Celebrate
celebrate.effect: The Pokémon congratulates you on your special day!

charge.name: Charge
charge.effect: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. This also raises the user's Sp. Def stat.

chargeBeam.name: Charge Beam
chargeBeam.effect: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The user may use any remaining electricity to raise its Sp. Atk stat.

charm.name: Charm
charm.effect: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.

chatter.name: Chatter
chatter.effect: The user attacks the target with sound waves of deafening chatter. This confuses the target.

chillingWater.name: Chilling Water
chillingWater.effect: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

chillyReception.name: Chilly Reception
chillyReception.effect: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.

chipAway.name: Chip Away
chipAway.effect: Looking for an opening, the user strikes consistently. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.

chloroblast.name: Chloroblast
chloroblast.effect: The user launches its amassed chlorophyll to inflict damage on the target. This also damages the user.

circleThrow.name: Circle Throw
circleThrow.effect: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

clamp.name: Clamp
clamp.effect: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

clangingScales.name: Clanging Scales
clangingScales.effect: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat goes down after the attack.

clangorousSoul.name: Clangorous Soul
clangorousSoul.effect: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

clangorousSoulblaze.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
clangorousSoulblaze.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user's stats.

clearSmog.name: Clear Smog
clearSmog.effect: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are returned to normal.

closeCombat.name: Close Combat
closeCombat.effect: The user fights the target up close without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

coaching.name: Coaching
coaching.effect: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

coil.name: Coil
coil.effect: The user coils up and concentrates. This raises its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.

collisionCourse.name: Collision Course
collisionCourse.effect: The user transforms and crashes to the ground, causing a massive prehistoric explosion. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

combatTorque.name: Combat Torque
combatTorque.effect: The user revs their engine forcefully into the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

cometPunch.name: Comet Punch
cometPunch.effect: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

comeuppance.name: Comeuppance
comeuppance.effect: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

confide.name: Confide
confide.effect: The user tells the target a secret, and the target loses its ability to concentrate. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

confuseRay.name: Confuse Ray
confuseRay.effect: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

confusion.name: Confusion
confusion.effect: The target is hit by a weak telekinetic force. This may also confuse the target.

constrict.name: Constrict
constrict.effect: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target's  Speed stat.

continentalCrushPhysical.name: Continental Crush
continentalCrushPhysical.effect: The user summons a huge rock mountain using its Z-Power and drops it onto the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

conversion.name: Conversion
conversion.effect: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

conversion2.name: Conversion 2
conversion2.effect: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the target used last.

copycat.name: Copycat
copycat.effect: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.

coreEnforcer.name: Core Enforcer
coreEnforcer.effect: If the Pokémon the user has inflicted damage on have already used their moves, this move eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.

corkscrewCrashPhysical.name: Corkscrew Crash
corkscrewCrashPhysical.effect: The user spins very fast and rams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

corrosiveGas.name: Corrosive Gas
corrosiveGas.effect: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

cosmicPower.name: Cosmic Power
cosmicPower.effect: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to raise its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

cottonGuard.name: Cotton Guard
cottonGuard.effect: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, which drastically raises the user's Defense stat.

cottonSpore.name: Cotton Spore
cottonSpore.effect: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon, which harshly lowers their Speed stats.

counter.name: Counter
counter.effect: A retaliation move that counters any physical attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

courtChange.name: Court Change
courtChange.effect: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

covet.name: Covet
covet.effect: The user endearingly approaches the target, then has a 30% chance to steal the target's held item.

crabhammer.name: Crabhammer
crabhammer.effect: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

craftyShield.name: Crafty Shield
craftyShield.effect: The user protects itself and its allies from status moves with a mysterious power. This does not stop moves that do damage.

crossChop.name: Cross Chop
crossChop.effect: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

crossPoison.name: Cross Poison
crossPoison.effect: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

crunch.name: Crunch
crunch.effect: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crushClaw.name: Crush Claw
crushClaw.effect: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

crushGrip.name: Crush Grip
crushGrip.effect: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater this move's power.

curse.name: Curse
curse.effect: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

cut.name: Cut
cut.effect: The target is cut with a scythe or claw.

darkPulse.name: Dark Pulse
darkPulse.effect: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with dark thoughts. This may also make the target flinch.

darkVoid.name: Dark Void
darkVoid.effect: Opposing Pokémon are dragged into a world of total darkness that makes them sleep.

darkestLariat.name: Darkest Lariat
darkestLariat.effect: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.

dazzlingGleam.name: Dazzling Gleam
dazzlingGleam.effect: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

decorate.name: Decorate
decorate.effect: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

defendOrder.name: Defend Order
defendOrder.effect: The user calls out its underlings to shield its body, raising its Defense and Sp. Def stats.

defenseCurl.name: Defense Curl
defenseCurl.effect: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

defog.name: Defog
defog.effect: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

destinyBond.name: Destiny Bond
destinyBond.effect: After using this move, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

detect.name: Detect
detect.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

devastatingDrakePhysical.name: Devastating Drake
devastatingDrakePhysical.effect: The user materializes its aura using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

diamondStorm.name: Diamond Storm
diamondStorm.effect: The user whips up a storm of diamonds to damage opposing Pokémon. This may also sharply raise the user's Defense stat.

dig.name: Dig
dig.effect: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn.

direClaw.name: Dire Claw
direClaw.effect: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. This may also leave the target poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep.

disable.name: Disable
disable.effect: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

disarmingVoice.name: Disarming Voice
disarmingVoice.effect: Letting out a charming cry, the user does emotional damage to opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

discharge.name: Discharge
discharge.effect: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also cause paralysis.

dive.name: Dive
dive.effect: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

dizzyPunch.name: Dizzy Punch
dizzyPunch.effect: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.

doodle.name: Doodle
doodle.effect: The user captures the very essence of the target in a sketch. This changes the Abilities of the user and its ally Pokémon to that of the target.

doomDesire.name: Doom Desire
doomDesire.effect: Two turns after this move is used, a concentrated bundle of light blasts the target.

doubleEdge.name: Double-Edge
doubleEdge.effect: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

doubleHit.name: Double Hit
doubleHit.effect: The user slams the target with a long tail, vines, or a tentacle. The target is hit twice in a row.

doubleIronBash.name: Double Iron Bash
doubleIronBash.effect: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

doubleKick.name: Double Kick
doubleKick.effect: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

doubleShock.name: Double Shock
doubleShock.effect: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.

doubleSlap.name: Double Slap
doubleSlap.effect: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

doubleTeam.name: Double Team
doubleTeam.effect: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

dracoMeteor.name: Draco Meteor
dracoMeteor.effect: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

dragonAscent.name: Dragon Ascent
dragonAscent.effect: After soaring upward, the user attacks its target by dropping out of the sky at high speeds. But it lowers its own Defense and Sp. Def stats in the process.

dragonBreath.name: Dragon Breath
dragonBreath.effect: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

dragonCheer.name: Dragon Cheer
dragonCheer.effect: The user raises its allies' morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.

dragonClaw.name: Dragon Claw
dragonClaw.effect: The user slashes the target with huge sharp claws.

dragonDance.name: Dragon Dance
dragonDance.effect: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that raises its Attack and Speed stats.

dragonDarts.name: Dragon Darts
dragonDarts.effect: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.

dragonEnergy.name: Dragon Energy
dragonEnergy.effect: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

dragonHammer.name: Dragon Hammer
dragonHammer.effect: The user uses its body like a hammer to attack the target and inflict damage.

dragonPulse.name: Dragon Pulse
dragonPulse.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

dragonRage.name: Dragon Rage
dragonRage.effect: This attack hits the target with a shock wave of pure rage. This attack always inflicts 40 HP damage.

dragonRush.name: Dragon Rush
dragonRush.effect: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.

dragonTail.name: Dragon Tail
dragonTail.effect: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

drainPunch.name: Drain Punch
drainPunch.effect: An energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

drainingKiss.name: Draining Kiss
drainingKiss.effect: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

dreamEater.name: Dream Eater
dreamEater.effect: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

drillPeck.name: Drill Peck
drillPeck.effect: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

drillRun.name: Drill Run
drillRun.effect: The user crashes into its target while rotating its body like a drill. Critical hits land more easily.

drumBeating.name: Drum Beating
drumBeating.effect: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

dualChop.name: Dual Chop
dualChop.effect: The user attacks its target by hitting it with brutal strikes. The target is hit twice in a row.

dualWingbeat.name: Dual Wingbeat
dualWingbeat.effect: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

dynamaxCannon.name: Dynamax Cannon
dynamaxCannon.effect: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. Deals up to twice the damage if the target is overly leveled.

dynamicPunch.name: Dynamic Punch
dynamicPunch.effect: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. This confuses the target if it hits.

earthPower.name: Earth Power
earthPower.effect: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

earthquake.name: Earthquake
earthquake.effect: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

echoedVoice.name: Echoed Voice
echoedVoice.effect: The user attacks the target with an echoing voice. If this move is used every turn, its power is increased.

eerieImpulse.name: Eerie Impulse
eerieImpulse.effect: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

eerieSpell.name: Eerie Spell
eerieSpell.effect: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

eggBomb.name: Egg Bomb
eggBomb.effect: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

electricTerrain.name: Electric Terrain
electricTerrain.effect: The user electrifies the ground for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground no longer fall asleep.

electrify.name: Electrify
electrify.effect: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target's move becomes Electric type.

electroBall.name: Electro Ball
electroBall.effect: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.

electroDrift.name: Electro Drift
electroDrift.effect: The user races forward at ultrafast speeds, piercing its target with futuristic electricity. This move's power is boosted more than usual if it's a supereffective hit.

electroShot.name: Electro Shot
electroShot.effect: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.

electroweb.name: Electroweb
electroweb.effect: The user attacks and captures opposing Pokémon using an electric net. This lowers their Speed stats.

embargo.name: Embargo
embargo.effect: This move prevents the target from using its held item for five turns. Its Trainer is also prevented from using items on it.

ember.name: Ember
ember.effect: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

encore.name: Encore
encore.effect: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

endeavor.name: Endeavor
endeavor.effect: This attack move cuts down the target's HP to equal the user's HP.

endure.name: Endure
endure.effect: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

energyBall.name: Energy Ball
energyBall.effect: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

entrainment.name: Entrainment
entrainment.effect: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.

eruption.name: Eruption
eruption.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

esperWing.name: Esper Wing
esperWing.effect: The user slashes the target with aura-enriched wings. This also boosts the user's Speed stat. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

eternabeam.name: Eternabeam
eternabeam.effect: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

expandingForce.name: Expanding Force
expandingForce.effect: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. This move's power goes up and damages all opposing Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.

explosion.name: Explosion
explosion.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

extrasensory.name: Extrasensory
extrasensory.effect: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.

extremeEvoboost.name: Extreme Evoboost
extremeEvoboost.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Eevee, gets energy from its evolved friends and boosts its stats sharply.

extremeSpeed.name: Extreme Speed
extremeSpeed.effect: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

facade.name: Facade
facade.effect: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

fairyLock.name: Fairy Lock
fairyLock.effect: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.

fairyWind.name: Fairy Wind
fairyWind.effect: The user stirs up a fairy wind and strikes the target with it.

fakeOut.name: Fake Out
fakeOut.effect: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn each time the user enters battle.

fakeTears.name: Fake Tears
fakeTears.effect: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

falseSurrender.name: False Surrender
falseSurrender.effect: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

falseSwipe.name: False Swipe
falseSwipe.effect: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

featherDance.name: Feather Dance
featherDance.effect: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

feint.name: Feint
feint.effect: This attack hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.

feintAttack.name: Feint Attack
feintAttack.effect: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

fellStinger.name: Fell Stinger
fellStinger.effect: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat rises drastically.

fickleBeam.name: Fickle Beam
fickleBeam.effect: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.

fieryDance.name: Fiery Dance
fieryDance.effect: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by dancing and flapping its wings. This may also raise the user's Sp. Atk stat.

fieryWrath.name: Fiery Wrath
fieryWrath.effect: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

filletAway.name: Fillet Away
filletAway.effect: The user sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats by using its own HP.

finalGambit.name: Final Gambit
finalGambit.effect: The user risks everything to attack its target. The user faints but does damage equal to its HP.

fireBlast.name: Fire Blast
fireBlast.effect: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

fireFang.name: Fire Fang
fireFang.effect: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.

fireLash.name: Fire Lash
fireLash.effect: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

firePledge.name: Fire Pledge
firePledge.effect: A column of fire hits the target. When used with its grass equivalent, its power increases and a vast sea of fire appears.

firePunch.name: Fire Punch
firePunch.effect: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.

fireSpin.name: Fire Spin
fireSpin.effect: The target becomes trapped within a fierce vortex of fire that rages for four to five turns.

firstImpression.name: First Impression
firstImpression.effect: Although this move has great power, it only works the first turn each time the user enters battle.

fishiousRend.name: Fishious Rend
fishiousRend.effect: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

fissure.name: Fissure
fissure.effect: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

flail.name: Flail
flail.effect: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.

flameBurst.name: Flame Burst
flameBurst.effect: The user attacks the target with a bursting flame. The bursting flame damages Pokémon next to the target as well.

flameCharge.name: Flame Charge
flameCharge.effect: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up more power, the user raises its Speed stat.

flameWheel.name: Flame Wheel
flameWheel.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.effect: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

flareBlitz.name: Flare Blitz
flareBlitz.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with a burn.

flash.name: Flash
flash.effect: The user flashes a bright light that cuts the target's accuracy.

flashCannon.name: Flash Cannon
flashCannon.effect: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it all at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

flatter.name: Flatter
flatter.effect: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also raises the target's Sp. Atk stat.

fleurCannon.name: Fleur Cannon
fleurCannon.effect: The user unleashes a strong beam. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

fling.name: Fling
fling.effect: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

flipTurn.name: Flip Turn
flipTurn.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

floatyFall.name: Floaty Fall
floatyFall.effect: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This may also make the target flinch.

floralHealing.name: Floral Healing
floralHealing.effect: The user restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP when the terrain is grass.

flowerShield.name: Flower Shield
flowerShield.effect: The user raises the Defense stats of all Grass-type Pokémon in battle with a mysterious power.

flowerTrick.name: Flower Trick
flowerTrick.effect: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.

fly.name: Fly
fly.effect: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn.

flyingPress.name: Flying Press
flyingPress.effect: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.

focusBlast.name: Focus Blast
focusBlast.effect: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

focusEnergy.name: Focus Energy
focusEnergy.effect: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

focusPunch.name: Focus Punch
focusPunch.effect: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

followMe.name: Follow Me
followMe.effect: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

forcePalm.name: Force Palm
forcePalm.effect: The target is attacked with a shock wave. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

foresight.name: Foresight
foresight.effect: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

forestsCurse.name: Forest's Curse
forestsCurse.effect: The user puts a forest curse on the target. The target is now Grass type as well.

foulPlay.name: Foul Play
foulPlay.effect: The user turns the target's power against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage it deals.

freezeDry.name: Freeze-Dry
freezeDry.effect: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.

freezeShock.name: Freeze Shock
freezeShock.effect: On the second turn, the user hits the target with electrically charged ice. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

freezingGlare.name: Freezing Glare
freezingGlare.effect: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

freezyFrost.name: Freezy Frost
freezyFrost.effect: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

frenzyPlant.name: Frenzy Plant
frenzyPlant.effect: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.

frostBreath.name: Frost Breath
frostBreath.effect: The user blows its cold breath on the target. This attack always results in a critical hit.

frustration.name: Frustration
frustration.effect: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

furyAttack.name: Fury Attack
furyAttack.effect: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

furyCutter.name: Fury Cutter
furyCutter.effect: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

furySwipes.name: Fury Swipes
furySwipes.effect: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.

fusionBolt.name: Fusion Bolt
fusionBolt.effect: The user throws down a giant lightning bolt. This move's power is increased when influenced by an enormous flame.

fusionFlare.name: Fusion Flare
fusionFlare.effect: The user brings down a giant flame. This move's power is increased when influenced by an enormous lightning bolt.

futureSight.name: Future Sight
futureSight.effect: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

gMaxBefuddle.name: G-Max Befuddle
gMaxBefuddle.effect: A Bug-type attack that Gigantamax Butterfree use. This move inflicts the poisoned, paralyzed, or asleep status condition on opponents.

gMaxCannonade.name: G-Max Cannonade
gMaxCannonade.effect: A Water-type attack that Gigantamax Blastoise use. This move continues to deal damage to opponents for four turns.

gMaxCentiferno.name: G-Max Centiferno
gMaxCentiferno.effect: A Fire-type attack that Gigantamax Centiskorch use. This move traps opponents in flames for four to five turns.

gMaxChiStrike.name: G-Max Chi Strike
gMaxChiStrike.effect: A Fighting-type attack that Gigantamax Machamp use. This move raises the chance of critical hits.

gMaxCuddle.name: G-Max Cuddle
gMaxCuddle.effect: A Normal-type attack that Gigantamax Eevee use. This move infatuates opponents.

gMaxDepletion.name: G-Max Depletion
gMaxDepletion.effect: A Dragon-type attack that Gigantamax Duraludon use. Reduces the PP of the last move used.

gMaxDrumSolo.name: G-Max Drum Solo
gMaxDrumSolo.effect: A Grass-type attack that Gigantamax Rillaboom use. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

gMaxFinale.name: G-Max Finale
gMaxFinale.effect: A Fairy-type attack that Gigantamax Alcremie use. This move heals the HP of allies.

gMaxFireball.name: G-Max Fireball
gMaxFireball.effect: A Fire-type attack that Gigantamax Cinderace use. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

gMaxFoamBurst.name: G-Max Foam Burst
gMaxFoamBurst.effect: A Water-type attack that Gigantamax Kingler use. This move harshly lowers the Speed of opponents.

gMaxGoldRush.name: G-Max Gold Rush
gMaxGoldRush.effect: A Normal-type attack that Gigantamax Meowth use. This move confuses opponents and also earns extra money.

gMaxGravitas.name: G-Max Gravitas
gMaxGravitas.effect: A Psychic-type attack that Gigantamax Orbeetle use. This move changes gravity for five turns.

gMaxHydrosnipe.name: G-Max Hydrosnipe
gMaxHydrosnipe.effect: A Water-type attack that Gigantamax Inteleon use. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

gMaxMalodor.name: G-Max Malodor
gMaxMalodor.effect: A Poison-type attack that Gigantamax Garbodor use. This move poisons opponents.

gMaxMeltdown.name: G-Max Meltdown
gMaxMeltdown.effect: A Steel-type attack that Gigantamax Melmetal use. This move makes opponents incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

gMaxOneBlow.name: G-Max One Blow
gMaxOneBlow.effect: A Dark-type attack that Gigantamax Urshifu use. This single-strike move can ignore Max Guard.

gMaxRapidFlow.name: G-Max Rapid Flow
gMaxRapidFlow.effect: A Water-type attack that Gigantamax Urshifu use. This rapid-strike move can ignore Max Guard.

gMaxReplenish.name: G-Max Replenish
gMaxReplenish.effect: A Normal-type attack that Gigantamax Snorlax use. This move restores Berries that have been eaten.

gMaxResonance.name: G-Max Resonance
gMaxResonance.effect: An Ice-type attack that Gigantamax Lapras use. This move reduces the damage received for five turns.

gMaxSandblast.name: G-Max Sandblast
gMaxSandblast.effect: A Ground-type attack that Gigantamax Sandaconda use. Opponents are trapped in a raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

gMaxSmite.name: G-Max Smite
gMaxSmite.effect: A Fairy-type attack that Gigantamax Hatterene use. This move confuses opponents.

gMaxSnooze.name: G-Max Snooze
gMaxSnooze.effect: A Dark-type attack that Gigantamax Grimmsnarl use. The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the targets into falling asleep on the next turn.

gMaxSteelsurge.name: G-Max Steelsurge
gMaxSteelsurge.effect: A Steel-type attack that Gigantamax Copperajah use. This move scatters sharp spikes around the field.

gMaxStonesurge.name: G-Max Stonesurge
gMaxStonesurge.effect: A Water-type attack that Gigantamax Drednaw use. This move scatters sharp rocks around the field.

gMaxStunShock.name: G-Max Stun Shock
gMaxStunShock.effect: An Electric-type attack that Gigantamax Toxtricity use. This move poisons or paralyzes opponents.

gMaxSweetness.name: G-Max Sweetness
gMaxSweetness.effect: A Grass-type attack that Gigantamax Appletun use. This move heals the status conditions of allies.

gMaxTartness.name: G-Max Tartness
gMaxTartness.effect: A Grass-type attack that Gigantamax Flapple use. This move reduces the opponents' evasiveness.

gMaxTerror.name: G-Max Terror
gMaxTerror.effect: A Ghost-type attack that Gigantamax Gengar use. This Pokémon steps on the opposing Pokémon's shadow to prevent them from escaping.

gMaxVineLash.name: G-Max Vine Lash
gMaxVineLash.effect: A Grass-type attack that Gigantamax Venusaur use. This move continues to deal damage to opponents for four turns.

gMaxVolcalith.name: G-Max Volcalith
gMaxVolcalith.effect: A Rock-type attack that Gigantamax Coalossal use. This move continues to deal damage to opponents for four turns.

gMaxVoltCrash.name: G-Max Volt Crash
gMaxVoltCrash.effect: An Electric-type attack that Gigantamax Pikachu use. This move paralyzes opponents.

gMaxWildfire.name: G-Max Wildfire
gMaxWildfire.effect: A Fire-type attack that Gigantamax Charizard use. This move continues to deal damage to opponents for four turns.

gMaxWindRage.name: G-Max Wind Rage
gMaxWindRage.effect: A Flying-type attack that Gigantamax Corviknight use. This move removes the effects of moves like Reflect and Light Screen.

gastroAcid.name: Gastro Acid
gastroAcid.effect: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.

gearGrind.name: Gear Grind
gearGrind.effect: The user attacks by throwing steel gears at its target twice.

gearUp.name: Gear Up
gearUp.effect: The user engages its gears to raise the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

genesisSupernova.name: Genesis Supernova
genesisSupernova.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mew, attacks the target with full force. The terrain will be charged with psychic energy.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.effect: The user absorbs energy and sharply raises its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats on the next turn.

gigaDrain.name: Giga Drain
gigaDrain.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

gigaImpact.name: Giga Impact
gigaImpact.effect: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power. The user can't move on the next turn.

gigatonHammer.name: Gigaton Hammer
gigatonHammer.effect: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.

gigavoltHavocPhysical.name: Gigavolt Havoc
gigavoltHavocPhysical.effect: The user hits the target with a powerful electric current collected by its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

glacialLance.name: Glacial Lance
glacialLance.effect: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

glaciate.name: Glaciate
glaciate.effect: The user attacks by blowing freezing cold air at opposing Pokémon. This lowers their Speed stats.

glaiveRush.name: Glaive Rush
glaiveRush.effect: The user throws its entire body into a reckless charge. After this move is used, attacks on the user cannot miss and will inflict double damage until the user's next turn.

glare.name: Glare
glare.effect: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

glitzyGlow.name: Glitzy Glow
glitzyGlow.effect: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon's special moves.

grassKnot.name: Grass Knot
grassKnot.effect: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

grassPledge.name: Grass Pledge
grassPledge.effect: A column of grass hits the target. When used with its water equivalent, its power increases and a vast swamp appears.

grassWhistle.name: Grass Whistle
grassWhistle.effect: The user plays a pleasant melody that lulls the target into a deep sleep.

grassyGlide.name: Grassy Glide
grassyGlide.effect: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

grassyTerrain.name: Grassy Terrain
grassyTerrain.effect: The user turns the ground to grass for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.

gravApple.name: Grav Apple
gravApple.effect: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

gravity.name: Gravity
gravity.effect: This move enables Flying-type Pokémon or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves. Moves that involve flying can't be used.

growl.name: Growl
growl.effect: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

growth.name: Growth
growth.effect: The user's body grows all at once, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

grudge.name: Grudge
grudge.effect: If the user faints, the user's grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent's move that knocked it out.

guardSplit.name: Guard Split
guardSplit.effect: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.

guardSwap.name: Guard Swap
guardSwap.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.

guardianOfAlola.name: Guardian of Alola
guardianOfAlola.effect: The user, the Land Spirit Pokémon, obtains Alola's energy using its Z-Power and attacks the target with full force. This reduces the target's HP greatly.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.effect: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

gunkShot.name: Gunk Shot
gunkShot.effect: The user shoots filthy garbage at the target to attack. This may also poison the target.

gust.name: Gust
gust.effect: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

gyroBall.name: Gyro Ball
gyroBall.effect: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user compared to the target, the greater the move's power.

hail.name: Hail
hail.effect: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

hammerArm.name: Hammer Arm
hammerArm.effect: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

happyHour.name: Happy Hour
happyHour.effect: Using Happy Hour doubles the amount of prize money received after battle.

hardPress.name: Hard Press
hardPress.effect: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.

harden.name: Harden
harden.effect: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

haze.name: Haze
haze.effect: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

headCharge.name: Head Charge
headCharge.effect: The user charges its head into its target, using its powerful guard hair. This also damages the user a little.

headSmash.name: Head Smash
headSmash.effect: The user attacks the target with a hazardous, full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.

headbutt.name: Headbutt
headbutt.effect: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

headlongRush.name: Headlong Rush
headlongRush.effect: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

healBell.name: Heal Bell
healBell.effect: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokémon.

healBlock.name: Heal Block
healBlock.effect: For five turns, the user prevents the opposing team from using any moves, Abilities, or held items that recover HP.

healOrder.name: Heal Order
healOrder.effect: The user calls out its underlings to heal it. The user regains up to half of its max HP.

healPulse.name: Heal Pulse
healPulse.effect: The user emits a healing pulse that restores the target's HP by up to half of its max HP.

healingWish.name: Healing Wish
healingWish.effect: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its HP restored and status conditions cured.

heartStamp.name: Heart Stamp
heartStamp.effect: The user unleashes a vicious blow after its cute act makes the target less wary. This may also make the target flinch.

heartSwap.name: Heart Swap
heartSwap.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch stat changes with the target.

heatCrash.name: Heat Crash
heatCrash.effect: The user slams its target with its flame-covered body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

heatWave.name: Heat Wave
heatWave.effect: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

heavySlam.name: Heavy Slam
heavySlam.effect: The user slams into the target with its heavy body. The more the user outweighs the target, the greater the move's power.

helpingHand.name: Helping Hand
helpingHand.effect: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

hex.name: Hex
hex.effect: This relentless attack does massive damage to a target affected by status conditions.

hiddenPower.name: Hidden Power
hiddenPower.effect: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

highHorsepower.name: High Horsepower
highHorsepower.effect: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

highJumpKick.name: High Jump Kick
highJumpKick.effect: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

holdBack.name: Hold Back
holdBack.effect: The user holds back when it attacks, and the target is left with at least 1 HP.

holdHands.name: Hold Hands
holdHands.effect: The user and an ally hold hands. This makes them very happy.

honeClaws.name: Hone Claws
honeClaws.effect: The user sharpens its claws to boost its Attack stat and accuracy.

hornAttack.name: Horn Attack
hornAttack.effect: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

hornDrill.name: Horn Drill
hornDrill.effect: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

hornLeech.name: Horn Leech
hornLeech.effect: The user drains the target's energy with its horns. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

howl.name: Howl
howl.effect: The user howls loudly to raise the spirit of itself and allies. This raises their Attack stats.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.effect: The user attacks by wrapping its opponent in a fierce wind that flies up into the sky. This may also confuse the target.

hydroCannon.name: Hydro Cannon
hydroCannon.effect: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can't move on the next turn.

hydroPump.name: Hydro Pump
hydroPump.effect: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

hydroSteam.name: Hydro Steam
hydroSteam.effect: The user blasts the target with boiling-hot water. This move's power is not lowered in harsh sunlight but rather boosted by 50 percent.

hydroVortexPhysical.name: Hydro Vortex
hydroVortexPhysical.effect: The user creates a huge whirling current using its Z-Power to swallow the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

hyperBeam.name: Hyper Beam
hyperBeam.effect: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can't move on the next turn.

hyperDrill.name: Hyper Drill
hyperDrill.effect: The user spins the pointed part of its body at high speed to pierce the target. This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

hyperFang.name: Hyper Fang
hyperFang.effect: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

hyperVoice.name: Hyper Voice
hyperVoice.effect: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

hyperspaceFury.name: Hyperspace Fury
hyperspaceFury.effect: Using its many arms, the user unleashes a barrage of attacks that ignore the effects of moves like Protect and Detect. But the user's Defense stat falls.

hyperspaceHole.name: Hyperspace Hole
hyperspaceHole.effect: Using a hyperspace hole, the user appears right next to the target and strikes. This also hits a target using a move such as Protect or Detect.

hypnosis.name: Hypnosis
hypnosis.effect: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

iceBall.name: Ice Ball
iceBall.effect: The user attacks the target for five turns. The move's power increases each time it hits.

iceBeam.name: Ice Beam
iceBeam.effect: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

iceBurn.name: Ice Burn
iceBurn.effect: On the second turn, an ultracold, freezing wind surrounds the target. This may leave the target with a burn.

iceFang.name: Ice Fang
iceFang.effect: The user bites with cold-infused fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it frozen.

iceHammer.name: Ice Hammer
iceHammer.effect: The user swings and hits with its strong, heavy fist. It lowers the user's Speed, however.

icePunch.name: Ice Punch
icePunch.effect: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

iceShard.name: Ice Shard
iceShard.effect: The user flash-freezes chunks of ice and hurls them at the target. This move always goes first.

iceSpinner.name: Ice Spinner
iceSpinner.effect: The user covers its feet in thin ice and twirls around, slamming into the target. This move's spinning motion also destroys the terrain.

icicleCrash.name: Icicle Crash
icicleCrash.effect: The user attacks by harshly dropping large icicles onto the target. This may also make the target flinch.

icicleSpear.name: Icicle Spear
icicleSpear.effect: The user launches sharp icicles at the target two to five times in a row.

icyWind.name: Icy Wind
icyWind.effect: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon's Speed stats.

imprison.name: Imprison
imprison.effect: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

incinerate.name: Incinerate
incinerate.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with fire. If a Pokémon is holding a certain item, such as a Berry, the item becomes burned up and unusable.

infernalParade.name: Infernal Parade
infernalParade.effect: The user attacks with myriad fireballs. This may also leave the target with a burn. This move's power is doubled if the target has a status condition.

inferno.name: Inferno
inferno.effect: The user attacks by engulfing the target in an intense fire. This leaves the target with a burn.

infernoOverdrivePhysical.name: Inferno Overdrive
infernoOverdrivePhysical.effect: The user breathes a stream of intense fire toward the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies depending on the original move.

infestation.name: Infestation
infestation.effect: The target is infested and attacked for four to five turns. The target can't flee during this time.

ingrain.name: Ingrain
ingrain.effect: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it's rooted, it can't switch out.

instruct.name: Instruct
instruct.effect: The user instructs the target to use the target's last move again.

ionDeluge.name: Ion Deluge
ionDeluge.effect: The user disperses electrically charged particles, which changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

ironDefense.name: Iron Defense
ironDefense.effect: The user hardens its body's surface like iron, sharply raising its Defense stat.

ironHead.name: Iron Head
ironHead.effect: The user slams the target with its steel-hard head. This may also make the target flinch.

ironTail.name: Iron Tail
ironTail.effect: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

ivyCudgel.name: Ivy Cudgel
ivyCudgel.effect: The user strikes with an ivy-wrapped cudgel. This move's type changes depending on the mask worn by the user, and it has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

jawLock.name: Jaw Lock
jawLock.effect: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

jetPunch.name: Jet Punch
jetPunch.effect: The user summons a torrent around its fist and punches at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

judgment.name: Judgment
judgment.effect: The user releases countless shots of light at the target. This move's type varies depending on the kind of Plate the user is holding.

jumpKick.name: Jump Kick
jumpKick.effect: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

jungleHealing.name: Jungle Healing
jungleHealing.effect: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and healing any status conditions of itself and its ally Pokémon in battle.

karateChop.name: Karate Chop
karateChop.effect: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

kinesis.name: Kinesis
kinesis.effect: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target's accuracy.

kingsShield.name: King's Shield
kingsShield.effect: The user takes a defensive stance while it protects itself from damage. It also lowers the Attack stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

knockOff.name: Knock Off
knockOff.effect: The user slaps down the target's held item, and that item can't be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

kowtowCleave.name: Kowtow Cleave
kowtowCleave.effect: The user slashes at the target after kowtowing to make the target let down its guard. This attack never misses.

landsWrath.name: Land's Wrath
landsWrath.effect: The user gathers the energy of the land and focuses that power on opposing Pokémon to damage them.

laserFocus.name: Laser Focus
laserFocus.effect: The user concentrates intensely. The attack on the next turn always results in a critical hit.

lashOut.name: Lash Out
lashOut.effect: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user's stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

lastResort.name: Last Resort
lastResort.effect: This move can be used only after the user has used all the other moves it knows in the battle.

lastRespects.name: Last Respects
lastRespects.effect: The user attacks to avenge its allies. The more defeated allies there are in the user's party, the greater the move's power.

lavaPlume.name: Lava Plume
lavaPlume.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.

leafBlade.name: Leaf Blade
leafBlade.effect: The user handles a sharp leaf like a sword and attacks by cutting its target. Critical hits land more easily.

leafStorm.name: Leaf Storm
leafStorm.effect: The user whips up a storm of leaves around the target. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

leafTornado.name: Leaf Tornado
leafTornado.effect: The user attacks its target by encircling it in sharp leaves. This attack may also lower the target's accuracy.

leafage.name: Leafage
leafage.effect: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

leechLife.name: Leech Life
leechLife.effect: The user drains the target's blood. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

leechSeed.name: Leech Seed
leechSeed.effect: A seed is planted on the target. It steals some HP from the target every turn.

leer.name: Leer
leer.effect: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

letsSnuggleForever.name: Let's Snuggle Forever
letsSnuggleForever.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

lick.name: Lick
lick.effect: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

lifeDew.name: Life Dew
lifeDew.effect: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon in the battle.

lightOfRuin.name: Light of Ruin
lightOfRuin.effect: Drawing power from the Eternal Flower, the user fires a powerful beam of light. This also damages the user quite a lot.

lightScreen.name: Light Screen
lightScreen.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

lightThatBurnsTheSky.name: Light That Burns the Sky
lightThatBurnsTheSky.effect: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move ignores the target's Ability.

liquidation.name: Liquidation
liquidation.effect: The user slams into the target using a full-force blast of water. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

lockOn.name: Lock-On
lockOn.effect: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the next attack does not miss the target.

lovelyKiss.name: Lovely Kiss
lovelyKiss.effect: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

lowKick.name: Low Kick
lowKick.effect: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

lowSweep.name: Low Sweep
lowSweep.effect: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

luckyChant.name: Lucky Chant
luckyChant.effect: The user chants an incantation toward the sky, preventing opposing Pokémon from landing critical hits for five turns.

luminaCrash.name: Lumina Crash
luminaCrash.effect: The user attacks by unleashing a peculiar light that even affects the mind. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

lunarBlessing.name: Lunar Blessing
lunarBlessing.effect: The user receives a blessing from the crescent moon, restoring HP and curing status conditions for itself and its ally Pokémon currently in the battle.

lunarDance.name: Lunar Dance
lunarDance.effect: The user faints. In return, the Pokémon taking its place will have its status and HP fully restored.

lunge.name: Lunge
lunge.effect: The user makes a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

lusterPurge.name: Luster Purge
lusterPurge.effect: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

machPunch.name: Mach Punch
machPunch.effect: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

magicCoat.name: Magic Coat
magicCoat.effect: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.

magicPowder.name: Magic Powder
magicPowder.effect: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

magicRoom.name: Magic Room
magicRoom.effect: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's held items lose their effects for five turns.

magicalLeaf.name: Magical Leaf
magicalLeaf.effect: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

magicalTorque.name: Magical Torque
magicalTorque.effect: The user revs their fae-like engine into the target. This may also confuse the target.

magmaStorm.name: Magma Storm
magmaStorm.effect: The target becomes trapped within a maelstrom of fire that rages for four to five turns.

magnetBomb.name: Magnet Bomb
magnetBomb.effect: The user launches steel bombs that stick to the target. This attack never misses.

magnetRise.name: Magnet Rise
magnetRise.effect: The user levitates using electrically generated magnetism for five turns.

magneticFlux.name: Magnetic Flux
magneticFlux.effect: The user manipulates magnetic fields, which raises the Defense and Sp. Def stats of ally Pokémon with the Plus or Minus Ability.

magnitude.name: Magnitude
magnitude.effect: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.

makeItRain.name: Make It Rain
makeItRain.effect: The user attacks by throwing out a mass of coins. This also lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat. Money is earned after the battle.

maliciousMoonsault.name: Malicious Moonsault
maliciousMoonsault.effect: The user, Incineroar, strengthens its body using its Z-Power and crashes into the target with full force.

malignantChain.name: Malignant Chain
malignantChain.effect: The user pours toxins into the target by wrapping them in a toxic, corrosive chain. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

matBlock.name: Mat Block
matBlock.effect: Using a pulled-up mat as a shield, the user protects itself and its allies from damaging moves. This does not stop status moves.

matchaGotcha.name: Matcha Gotcha
matchaGotcha.effect: The user fires a blast of tea that it mixed. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

maxAirstream.name: Max Airstream
maxAirstream.effect: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Speed stats.

maxDarkness.name: Max Darkness
maxDarkness.effect: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

maxFlare.name: Max Flare
maxFlare.effect: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

maxFlutterby.name: Max Flutterby
maxFlutterby.effect: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

maxGeyser.name: Max Geyser
maxGeyser.effect: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.

maxGuard.name: Max Guard
maxGuard.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

maxHailstorm.name: Max Hailstorm
maxHailstorm.effect: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

maxKnuckle.name: Max Knuckle
maxKnuckle.effect: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Attack stats.

maxLightning.name: Max Lightning
maxLightning.effect: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.

maxMindstorm.name: Max Mindstorm
maxMindstorm.effect: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.

maxOoze.name: Max Ooze
maxOoze.effect: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Sp. Atk stats.

maxOvergrowth.name: Max Overgrowth
maxOvergrowth.effect: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.

maxPhantasm.name: Max Phantasm
maxPhantasm.effect: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Defense stat.

maxQuake.name: Max Quake
maxQuake.effect: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Sp. Def stats.

maxRockfall.name: Max Rockfall
maxRockfall.effect: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

maxStarfall.name: Max Starfall
maxStarfall.effect: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.

maxSteelspike.name: Max Steelspike
maxSteelspike.effect: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Defense stats.

maxStrike.name: Max Strike
maxStrike.effect: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Speed stat.

maxWyrmwind.name: Max Wyrmwind
maxWyrmwind.effect: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

meFirst.name: Me First
meFirst.effect: The user cuts ahead of the target to copy and use the target's intended move with greater power. This move fails if it isn't used first.

meanLook.name: Mean Look
meanLook.effect: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

meditate.name: Meditate
meditate.effect: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

megaDrain.name: Mega Drain
megaDrain.effect: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

megaKick.name: Mega Kick
megaKick.effect: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

megaPunch.name: Mega Punch
megaPunch.effect: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

megahorn.name: Megahorn
megahorn.effect: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

memento.name: Memento
memento.effect: The user faints when using this move. In return, this harshly lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

menacingMoonrazeMaelstrom.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
menacingMoonrazeMaelstrom.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.

metalBurst.name: Metal Burst
metalBurst.effect: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.

metalClaw.name: Metal Claw
metalClaw.effect: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also raise the user's Attack stat.

metalSound.name: Metal Sound
metalSound.effect: A horrible sound like scraping metal harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

meteorAssault.name: Meteor Assault
meteorAssault.effect: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can't move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.

meteorBeam.name: Meteor Beam
meteorBeam.effect: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.

meteorMash.name: Meteor Mash
meteorMash.effect: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also raise the user's Attack stat.

metronome.name: Metronome
metronome.effect: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

mightyCleave.name: Mighty Cleave
mightyCleave.effect: The user wields the light that has accumulated atop its head to cleave the target. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

milkDrink.name: Milk Drink
milkDrink.effect: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

mimic.name: Mimic
mimic.effect: The user copies the target's last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

mindBlown.name: Mind Blown
mindBlown.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

mindReader.name: Mind Reader
