mindReader.effect: The user senses the target's movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

minimize.name: Minimize
minimize.effect: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

miracleEye.name: Miracle Eye
miracleEye.effect: Enables a Dark-type target to be hit by Psychic-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

mirrorCoat.name: Mirror Coat
mirrorCoat.effect: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

mirrorMove.name: Mirror Move
mirrorMove.effect: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.

mirrorShot.name: Mirror Shot
mirrorShot.effect: The user lets loose a flash of energy at the target from its polished body. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

mist.name: Mist
mist.effect: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

mistBall.name: Mist Ball
mistBall.effect: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

mistyExplosion.name: Misty Explosion
mistyExplosion.effect: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is increased on Misty Terrain.

mistyTerrain.name: Misty Terrain
mistyTerrain.effect: This protects Pokémon on the ground from status conditions and halves damage from Dragon-type moves for five turns.

moonblast.name: Moonblast
moonblast.effect: Borrowing the power of the moon, the user attacks the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moongeistBeam.name: Moongeist Beam
moongeistBeam.effect: The user emits a sinister ray to attack the target. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

moonlight.name: Moonlight
moonlight.effect: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

morningSun.name: Morning Sun
morningSun.effect: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

mortalSpin.name: Mortal Spin
mortalSpin.effect: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also poisons opposing Pokémon.

mountainGale.name: Mountain Gale
mountainGale.effect: The user hurls giant chunks of ice at the target to inflict damage. This may also make the target flinch.

mudBomb.name: Mud Bomb
mudBomb.effect: The user launches a hard-packed mud ball to attack. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

mudShot.name: Mud Shot
mudShot.effect: The user attacks by hurling a blob of mud at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

mudSlap.name: Mud-Slap
mudSlap.effect: The user hurls mud in the target's face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

mudSport.name: Mud Sport
mudSport.effect: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.

muddyWater.name: Muddy Water
muddyWater.effect: The user attacks by shooting muddy water at opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their accuracy.

multiAttack.name: Multi-Attack
multiAttack.effect: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move's type.

mysticalFire.name: Mystical Fire
mysticalFire.effect: The user attacks by breathing a special, hot fire. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

mysticalPower.name: Mystical Power
mysticalPower.effect: The user attacks by emitting a mysterious power. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

nastyPlot.name: Nasty Plot
nastyPlot.effect: The user stimulates its brain by thinking bad thoughts. This sharply raises the user's Sp. Atk stat.

naturalGift.name: Natural Gift
naturalGift.effect: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines the move's type and power.

naturePower.name: Nature Power
naturePower.effect: This attack makes use of nature's power. Its effects vary depending on the user's environment.

naturesMadness.name: Nature's Madness
naturesMadness.effect: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

needleArm.name: Needle Arm
needleArm.effect: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This may also make the target flinch.

neverEndingNightmarePhysical.name: Never-Ending Nightmare
neverEndingNightmarePhysical.effect: Deep-seated grudges summoned by the user's Z-Power trap the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

nightDaze.name: Night Daze
nightDaze.effect: The user lets loose a pitch-black shock wave at its target. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

nightShade.name: Night Shade
nightShade.effect: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

nightSlash.name: Night Slash
nightSlash.effect: The user slashes the target the instant an opportunity arises. Critical hits land more easily.

nightmare.name: Nightmare
nightmare.effect: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

noRetreat.name: No Retreat
noRetreat.effect: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

nobleRoar.name: Noble Roar
nobleRoar.effect: Letting out a noble roar, the user intimidates the target and lowers its Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

noxiousTorque.name: Noxious Torque
noxiousTorque.effect: The user revs their poisonous engine into the target. This may also poison the target.

nuggetOfSmitty.name: Nugget of Smitty
nuggetOfSmitty.effect: The user unleashes the devastating nugget of smitty, its elemental force surging with their secondary type (or primary type if no secondary exists).

nuzzle.name: Nuzzle
nuzzle.effect: The user attacks by nuzzling its electrified cheeks against the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

oblivionWing.name: Oblivion Wing
oblivionWing.effect: The user absorbs its target's HP. The user's HP is restored by over half of the damage taken by the target.

obstruct.name: Obstruct
obstruct.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker's Defense stat.

oceanicOperetta.name: Oceanic Operetta
oceanicOperetta.effect: The user, Primarina, summons a massive amount of  water using its Z-Power and attacks the target with  full force.

octazooka.name: Octazooka
octazooka.effect: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target's face or eyes. This may also lower the target's accuracy.

octolock.name: Octolock
octolock.effect: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

odorSleuth.name: Odor Sleuth
odorSleuth.effect: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

ominousWind.name: Ominous Wind
ominousWind.effect: The user blasts the target with a gust of repulsive wind. This may also raise all the user's stats at once.

orderUp.name: Order Up
orderUp.effect: The user attacks with elegant poise. If the user has a Tatsugiri in its mouth, this move boosts one of the user's stats based on the Tatsugiri's form.

originPulse.name: Origin Pulse
originPulse.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with countless beams of light that glow a deep and brilliant blue.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.effect: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

overdrive.name: Overdrive
overdrive.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

overheat.name: Overheat
overheat.effect: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

painSplit.name: Pain Split
painSplit.effect: The user adds its HP to the target's HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

parabolicCharge.name: Parabolic Charge
parabolicCharge.effect: The user attacks everything around it. The user's HP is restored by half the damage taken by those hit.

partingShot.name: Parting Shot
partingShot.effect: With a parting threat, the user lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats. Then it switches with a party Pokémon.

payDay.name: Pay Day
payDay.effect: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

payback.name: Payback
payback.effect: The user stores power, then attacks. If the user moves after the target, this attack's power will be doubled.

peck.name: Peck
peck.effect: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

perishSong.name: Perish Song
perishSong.effect: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

petalBlizzard.name: Petal Blizzard
petalBlizzard.effect: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and attacks everything around it.

petalDance.name: Petal Dance
petalDance.effect: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

phantomForce.name: Phantom Force
phantomForce.effect: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

photonGeyser.name: Photon Geyser
photonGeyser.effect: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.

pikaPapow.name: Pika Papow
pikaPapow.effect: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move's power. It never misses.

pinMissile.name: Pin Missile
pinMissile.effect: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

plasmaFists.name: Plasma Fists
plasmaFists.effect: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

playNice.name: Play Nice
playNice.effect: The user and the target become friends, and the target loses its will to fight. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

playRough.name: Play Rough
playRough.effect: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.

pluck.name: Pluck
pluck.effect: The user pecks the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.

poisonFang.name: Poison Fang
poisonFang.effect: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

poisonGas.name: Poison Gas
poisonGas.effect: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

poisonJab.name: Poison Jab
poisonJab.effect: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

poisonPowder.name: Poison Powder
poisonPowder.effect: The user scatters a cloud of poisonous dust that poisons the target.

poisonSting.name: Poison Sting
poisonSting.effect: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

poisonTail.name: Poison Tail
poisonTail.effect: The user hits the target with its tail. This may also poison the target. Critical hits land more easily.

pollenPuff.name: Pollen Puff
pollenPuff.effect: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.effect: The user attacks the target by controlling the target's item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

populationBomb.name: Population Bomb
populationBomb.effect: The user's fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.

pounce.name: Pounce
pounce.effect: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

pound.name: Pound
pound.effect: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

powder.name: Powder
powder.effect: The user covers the target in a combustible powder. If the target uses a Fire-type move, the powder explodes and damages the target.

powderSnow.name: Powder Snow
powderSnow.effect: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

powerGem.name: Power Gem
powerGem.effect: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

powerShift.name: Power Shift
powerShift.effect: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats.

powerSplit.name: Power Split
powerSplit.effect: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.

powerSwap.name: Power Swap
powerSwap.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.

powerTrick.name: Power Trick
powerTrick.effect: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.

powerTrip.name: Power Trip
powerTrip.effect: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the move's power.

powerUpPunch.name: Power-Up Punch
powerUpPunch.effect: Striking opponents over and over makes the user's fists harder. Hitting a target raises the Attack stat.

powerWhip.name: Power Whip
powerWhip.effect: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to harshly lash the target.

precipiceBlades.name: Precipice Blades
precipiceBlades.effect: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by manifesting the power of the land in fearsome blades of stone.

present.name: Present
present.effect: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

prismaticLaser.name: Prismatic Laser
prismaticLaser.effect: The user shoots powerful lasers using the power of a prism. The user can't move on the next turn.

protect.name: Protect
protect.effect: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

psybeam.name: Psybeam
psybeam.effect: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.

psyblade.name: Psyblade
psyblade.effect: The user rends the target with an ethereal blade. This move's power is boosted by 50 percent if the user is on Electric Terrain.

psychUp.name: Psych Up
psychUp.effect: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

psychic.name: Psychic
psychic.effect: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

psychicFangs.name: Psychic Fangs
psychicFangs.effect: The user bites the target with its psychic capabilities. This can also destroy Light Screen and Reflect.

psychicNoise.name: Psychic Noise
psychicNoise.effect: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.

psychicTerrain.name: Psychic Terrain
psychicTerrain.effect: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.

psychoBoost.name: Psycho Boost
psychoBoost.effect: The user attacks the target at full power. The attack's recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat.

psychoCut.name: Psycho Cut
psychoCut.effect: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. Critical hits land more easily.

psychoShift.name: Psycho Shift
psychoShift.effect: Using its psychic power of suggestion, the user transfers its status conditions to the target.

psyshieldBash.name: Psyshield Bash
psyshieldBash.effect: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user's Defense stat.

psyshock.name: Psyshock
psyshock.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

psystrike.name: Psystrike
psystrike.effect: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

psywave.name: Psywave
psywave.effect: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

pulverizingPancake.name: Pulverizing Pancake
pulverizingPancake.effect: Z-Power brings out the true capabilities of the user, Snorlax. The Pokémon moves its enormous body energetically and attacks the target with full force.

punishment.name: Punishment
punishment.effect: The more the target has powered up with stat changes, the greater the move's power.

purify.name: Purify
purify.effect: The user heals the target's status condition. If the move succeeds, it also restores the user's own HP.

pursuit.name: Pursuit
pursuit.effect: The power of this attack move is doubled if it's used on a target that's switching out of battle.

pyroBall.name: Pyro Ball
pyroBall.effect: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

quash.name: Quash
quash.effect: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.

quickAttack.name: Quick Attack
quickAttack.effect: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

quickGuard.name: Quick Guard
quickGuard.effect: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.

quiverDance.name: Quiver Dance
quiverDance.effect: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

rage.name: Rage
rage.effect: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

rageFist.name: Rage Fist
rageFist.effect: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.

ragePowder.name: Rage Powder
ragePowder.effect: The user scatters a cloud of irritating powder to draw attention to itself. Opposing Pokémon aim only at the user.

ragingBull.name: Raging Bull
ragingBull.effect: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

ragingFury.name: Raging Fury
ragingFury.effect: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

rainDance.name: Rain Dance
rainDance.effect: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

rapidSpin.name: Rapid Spin
rapidSpin.effect: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also raises the user's Speed stat.

razorLeaf.name: Razor Leaf
razorLeaf.effect: Sharp-edged leaves are launched to slash at opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

razorShell.name: Razor Shell
razorShell.effect: The user cuts its target with sharp shells. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

razorWind.name: Razor Wind
razorWind.effect: In this two-turn attack, blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

recover.name: Recover
recover.effect: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

recycle.name: Recycle
recycle.effect: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.effect: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

reflectType.name: Reflect Type
reflectType.effect: The user reflects the target's type, making the user the same type as the target.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.effect: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.

relicSong.name: Relic Song
relicSong.effect: The user sings an ancient song and attacks by appealing to the hearts of the listening opposing Pokémon. This may also induce sleep.

rest.name: Rest
rest.effect: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and heals any status conditions.

retaliate.name: Retaliate
retaliate.effect: The user gets revenge for a fainted ally. If an ally fainted in the previous turn, this move's power is increased.

return.name: Return
return.effect: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

revelationDance.name: Revelation Dance
revelationDance.effect: The user attacks the target by dancing very hard. The user's type determines the type of this move.

revenge.name: Revenge
revenge.effect: This attack move's power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.effect: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

revivalBlessing.name: Revival Blessing
revivalBlessing.effect: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.

risingVoltage.name: Rising Voltage
risingVoltage.effect: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move's power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

roar.name: Roar
roar.effect: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

roarOfTime.name: Roar of Time
roarOfTime.effect: The user blasts the target with power that distorts even time. The user can't move on the next turn.

rockBlast.name: Rock Blast
rockBlast.effect: The user hurls hard rocks at the target. Two to five rocks are launched in a row.

rockClimb.name: Rock Climb
rockClimb.effect: The user attacks the target by smashing into it with incredible force. This may also confuse the target.

rockPolish.name: Rock Polish
rockPolish.effect: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

rockSlide.name: Rock Slide
rockSlide.effect: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

rockSmash.name: Rock Smash
rockSmash.effect: The user attacks with a punch. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

rockThrow.name: Rock Throw
rockThrow.effect: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

rockTomb.name: Rock Tomb
rockTomb.effect: Boulders are hurled at the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by preventing its movement.

rockWrecker.name: Rock Wrecker
rockWrecker.effect: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.

rolePlay.name: Role Play
rolePlay.effect: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.

rollingKick.name: Rolling Kick
rollingKick.effect: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. This may also make the target flinch.

rollout.name: Rollout
rollout.effect: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

roost.name: Roost
roost.effect: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half of its max HP.

rototiller.name: Rototiller
rototiller.effect: Tilling the soil, the user makes it easier for plants to grow. This raises the Attack and Sp. Atk stats of Grass-type Pokémon.

round.name: Round
round.effect: The user attacks the target with a song. Others can join in the Round to increase the power of the attack.

ruination.name: Ruination
ruination.effect: The user summons a ruinous disaster. This cuts the target's HP in half.

sacredFire.name: Sacred Fire
sacredFire.effect: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.

sacredSword.name: Sacred Sword
sacredSword.effect: The user attacks by slicing with a long horn. The target's stat changes don't affect this attack's damage.

safeguard.name: Safeguard
safeguard.effect: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

saltCure.name: Salt Cure
saltCure.effect: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.

sandAttack.name: Sand Attack
sandAttack.effect: Sand is hurled in the target's face, reducing the target's accuracy.

sandTomb.name: Sand Tomb
sandTomb.effect: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm for four to five turns.

sandsearStorm.name: Sandsear Storm
sandsearStorm.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds and searingly hot sand. This may also leave them with a burn.

sandstorm.name: Sandstorm
sandstorm.effect: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

sappySeed.name: Sappy Seed
sappySeed.effect: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. The seeds drain the target's HP every turn.

savageSpinOutPhysical.name: Savage Spin-Out
savageSpinOutPhysical.effect: The user binds the target with full force with threads of silk that the user spits using its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

scald.name: Scald
scald.effect: The user shoots boiling hot water at its target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

scaleShot.name: Scale Shot
scaleShot.effect: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

scaryFace.name: Scary Face
scaryFace.effect: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

scorchingSands.name: Scorching Sands
scorchingSands.effect: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

scratch.name: Scratch
scratch.effect: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

screech.name: Screech
screech.effect: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.

searingShot.name: Searing Shot
searingShot.effect: The user torches everything around it in an inferno of scarlet flames. This may also leave those it hits with a burn.

searingSunrazeSmash.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
searingSunrazeSmash.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.

secretPower.name: Secret Power
secretPower.effect: The additional effects of this attack depend upon where it was used.

secretSword.name: Secret Sword
secretSword.effect: The user cuts with its long horn. The odd power contained in the horn does physical damage to the target.

seedBomb.name: Seed Bomb
seedBomb.effect: The user slams a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

seedFlare.name: Seed Flare
seedFlare.effect: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also harshly lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

seismicToss.name: Seismic Toss
seismicToss.effect: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.

selfDestruct.name: Self-Destruct
selfDestruct.effect: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

shadowBall.name: Shadow Ball
shadowBall.effect: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

shadowBone.name: Shadow Bone
shadowBone.effect: The user attacks by beating the target with a bone that contains a spirit. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.

shadowClaw.name: Shadow Claw
shadowClaw.effect: The user slashes with a sharp claw made from shadows. Critical hits land more easily.

shadowForce.name: Shadow Force
shadowForce.effect: The user disappears, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.

shadowPunch.name: Shadow Punch
shadowPunch.effect: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.

shadowSneak.name: Shadow Sneak
shadowSneak.effect: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

sharpen.name: Sharpen
sharpen.effect: The user makes its edges more jagged,  which raises its Attack stat.

shatteredPsychePhysical.name: Shattered Psyche
shatteredPsychePhysical.effect: The user controls the target with its Z-Power and hurts the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

shedTail.name: Shed Tail
shedTail.effect: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

sheerCold.name: Sheer Cold
sheerCold.effect: The target faints instantly. It's less likely to hit the target if it's used by Pokémon other than Ice types.

shellSideArm.name: Shell Side Arm
shellSideArm.effect: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. This may also poison the target.

shellSmash.name: Shell Smash
shellSmash.effect: The user breaks its shell, which lowers Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply raises its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

shellTrap.name: Shell Trap
shellTrap.effect: The user sets a shell trap. If the user is hit by a physical move, the trap will explode and inflict damage on opposing Pokémon.

shelter.name: Shelter
shelter.effect: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.

shiftGear.name: Shift Gear
shiftGear.effect: The user rotates its gears, raising its Attack stat and sharply raising its Speed stat.

shockWave.name: Shock Wave
shockWave.effect: The user strikes the target with a quick jolt of electricity. This attack never misses.

shoreUp.name: Shore Up
shoreUp.effect: The user regains up to half of its max HP. It restores more HP in a sandstorm.

signalBeam.name: Signal Beam
signalBeam.effect: The user attacks with a sinister beam of light. This may also confuse the target.

silkTrap.name: Silk Trap
silkTrap.effect: The user spins a silken trap, protecting itself from damage while lowering the Speed stat of any attacker that makes direct contact.

silverWind.name: Silver Wind
silverWind.effect: The target is attacked with powdery scales blown by the wind. This may also raise all the user's stats.

simpleBeam.name: Simple Beam
simpleBeam.effect: The user's mysterious psychic wave changes the target's Ability to Simple.

sing.name: Sing
sing.effect: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

sinisterArrowRaid.name: Sinister Arrow Raid
sinisterArrowRaid.effect: The user, Decidueye, creates countless arrows using its Z-Power and shoots the target with full force.

sizzlySlide.name: Sizzly Slide
sizzlySlide.effect: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also leaves the target with a burn.

sketch.name: Sketch
sketch.effect: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

skillSwap.name: Skill Swap
skillSwap.effect: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

skitterSmack.name: Skitter Smack
skitterSmack.effect: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

skullBash.name: Skull Bash
skullBash.effect: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

skyAttack.name: Sky Attack
skyAttack.effect: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.

skyDrop.name: Sky Drop
skyDrop.effect: The user takes the target into the sky, then drops it during the next turn. The target cannot attack while in the sky.

skyUppercut.name: Sky Uppercut
skyUppercut.effect: The user attacks the target with an uppercut thrown skyward with force.

slackOff.name: Slack Off
slackOff.effect: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

slam.name: Slam
slam.effect: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

slash.name: Slash
slash.effect: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

sleepPowder.name: Sleep Powder
sleepPowder.effect: The user scatters a big cloud of sleep-inducing dust around the target.

sleepTalk.name: Sleep Talk
sleepTalk.effect: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

sludge.name: Sludge
sludge.effect: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

sludgeBomb.name: Sludge Bomb
sludgeBomb.effect: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

sludgeWave.name: Sludge Wave
sludgeWave.effect: The user strikes everything around it by swamping the area with a giant sludge wave. This may also poison those hit.

smackDown.name: Smack Down
smackDown.effect: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. A flying Pokémon will fall to the ground when it's hit.

smartStrike.name: Smart Strike
smartStrike.effect: The user stabs the target with a sharp horn. This attack never misses.

smellingSalts.name: Smelling Salts
smellingSalts.effect: This attack's power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target's paralysis, however.

smittyNuggets.name: Smitty Nugget
smittyNuggets.effect: The user unleashes an almighty smitty nugget, their power manifesting as the user's secondary type (or primary type if no secondary exists).

smog.name: Smog
smog.effect: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.

smokescreen.name: Smokescreen
smokescreen.effect: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target's accuracy.

snapTrap.name: Snap Trap
snapTrap.effect: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

snarl.name: Snarl
snarl.effect: The user yells as if it's ranting about something, which lowers the Sp. Atk stats of opposing Pokémon.

snatch.name: Snatch
snatch.effect: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.

snipeShot.name: Snipe Shot
snipeShot.effect: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

snore.name: Snore
snore.effect: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

snowscape.name: Snowscape
snowscape.effect: The user summons a snowstorm lasting five turns. This boosts the Defense stats of Ice types.

soak.name: Soak
soak.effect: The user shoots a torrent of water at the target and changes the target's type to Water.

softBoiled.name: Soft-Boiled
softBoiled.effect: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

solarBeam.name: Solar Beam
solarBeam.effect: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light, then blasts a bundled beam on the next turn.

solarBlade.name: Solar Blade
solarBlade.effect: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers light and fills a blade with the light's energy, attacking the target on the next turn.

sonicBoom.name: Sonic Boom
sonicBoom.effect: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

soulStealing7StarStrike.name: Soul-Stealing 7-Star Strike
soulStealing7StarStrike.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Marshadow, punches and kicks the target consecutively with full force.

spacialRend.name: Spacial Rend
spacialRend.effect: The user tears the target along with the space around it. Critical hits land more easily.

spark.name: Spark
spark.effect: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

sparklingAria.name: Sparkling Aria
sparklingAria.effect: The user bursts into song, emitting many bubbles. Any Pokémon suffering from a burn will be healed by the touch of these bubbles.

sparklySwirl.name: Sparkly Swirl
sparklySwirl.effect: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user's party.

spectralThief.name: Spectral Thief
spectralThief.effect: The user hides in the target's shadow, steals the target's stat boosts, and then attacks.

speedSwap.name: Speed Swap
speedSwap.effect: The user exchanges Speed stats with the target.

spicyExtract.name: Spicy Extract
spicyExtract.effect: The user emits an incredibly spicy extract, sharply boosting the target's Attack stat and harshly lowering the target's Defense stat.

spiderWeb.name: Spider Web
spiderWeb.effect: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.

spikeCannon.name: Spike Cannon
spikeCannon.effect: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

spikes.name: Spikes
spikes.effect: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team's feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

spikyShield.name: Spiky Shield
spikyShield.effect: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also damages any attacker that makes direct contact.

spinOut.name: Spin Out
spinOut.effect: The user spins furiously by straining its legs, inflicting damage on the target. This also harshly lowers the user's Speed stat.

spiritBreak.name: Spirit Break
spiritBreak.effect: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

spiritShackle.name: Spirit Shackle
spiritShackle.effect: The user attacks while simultaneously stitching the target's shadow to the ground to prevent the target from escaping.

spitUp.name: Spit Up
spitUp.effect: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move's power.

spite.name: Spite
spite.effect: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

splash.name: Splash
splash.effect: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

splinteredStormshards.name: Splintered Stormshards
splinteredStormshards.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.

splishySplash.name: Splishy Splash
splishySplash.effect: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

spore.name: Spore
spore.effect: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

spotlight.name: Spotlight
spotlight.effect: The user shines a spotlight on the target so that only the target will be attacked during the turn.

springtideStorm.name: Springtide Storm
springtideStorm.effect: The user attacks by wrapping opposing Pokémon in fierce winds brimming with love and hate. This may also lower their Attack stats.

stealthRock.name: Stealth Rock
stealthRock.effect: The user lays a trap of levitating stones around the opposing team. The trap hurts opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

steamEruption.name: Steam Eruption
steamEruption.effect: The user immerses the target in superheated steam. This may also leave the target with a burn.

steamroller.name: Steamroller
steamroller.effect: The user crushes its target by rolling over the target with its rolled-up body. This may also make the target flinch.

steelBeam.name: Steel Beam
steelBeam.effect: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

steelRoller.name: Steel Roller
steelRoller.effect: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

steelWing.name: Steel Wing
steelWing.effect: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user's Defense stat.

stickyWeb.name: Sticky Web
stickyWeb.effect: The user weaves a sticky net around the opposing team, which lowers their Speed stats upon switching into battle.

stockpile.name: Stockpile
stockpile.effect: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def stats. The move can be used three times.

stokedSparksurfer.name: Stoked Sparksurfer
stokedSparksurfer.effect: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Alolan Raichu, attacks the target with full force. This move leaves the target with paralysis.

stomp.name: Stomp
stomp.effect: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

stompingTantrum.name: Stomping Tantrum
stompingTantrum.effect: Driven by frustration, the user attacks the target. If the user's previous move has failed, the power of this move doubles.

stoneAxe.name: Stone Axe
stoneAxe.effect: The user swings its stone axes at the target. Stone splinters left behind by this attack float around the target.

stoneEdge.name: Stone Edge
stoneEdge.effect: The user stabs the target from below with sharpened stones. Critical hits land more easily.

storedPower.name: Stored Power
storedPower.effect: The user attacks the target with stored power. The more the user's stats are raised, the greater the move's power.

stormThrow.name: Storm Throw
stormThrow.effect: The user strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

strangeSteam.name: Strange Steam
strangeSteam.effect: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

strength.name: Strength
strength.effect: The target is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power.

strengthSap.name: Strength Sap
strengthSap.effect: The user restores its HP by the same amount as the target's Attack stat. It also lowers the target's Attack stat.

stringShot.name: String Shot
stringShot.effect: Opposing Pokémon are bound with silk blown from the user's mouth that harshly lowers the Speed stat.

struggle.name: Struggle
struggle.effect: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.

struggleBug.name: Struggle Bug
struggleBug.effect: While resisting, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. This lowers the Sp. Atk stats of those hit.

stuffCheeks.name: Stuff Cheeks
stuffCheeks.effect: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

stunSpore.name: Stun Spore
stunSpore.effect: The user scatters a cloud of numbing powder that paralyzes the target.

submission.name: Submission
submission.effect: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.

substitute.name: Substitute
substitute.effect: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

subzeroSlammerPhysical.name: Subzero Slammer
subzeroSlammerPhysical.effect: The user dramatically drops the temperature using its Z-Power and freezes the target with full force. The power varies, depending on the original move.

suckerPunch.name: Sucker Punch
suckerPunch.effect: This move enables the user to attack first. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

sunnyDay.name: Sunny Day
sunnyDay.effect: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

sunsteelStrike.name: Sunsteel Strike
sunsteelStrike.effect: The user slams into the target with the force of a meteor. This move can be used on the target regardless of its Abilities.

superFang.name: Super Fang
superFang.effect: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.

supercellSlam.name: Supercell Slam
supercellSlam.effect: The user electrifies its body and drops onto the target to inflict damage. If this move misses, the user takes damage instead.

superpower.name: Superpower
superpower.effect: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

supersonic.name: Supersonic
supersonic.effect: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

supersonicSkystrikePhysical.name: Supersonic Skystrike
supersonicSkystrikePhysical.effect: The user soars up with its Z-Power and plummets toward the target at full speed. The power varies, depending on the original move.

surf.name: Surf
surf.effect: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

surgingStrikes.name: Surging Strikes
surgingStrikes.effect: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This attack always results in a critical hit.

swagger.name: Swagger
swagger.effect: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target's Attack stat.

swallow.name: Swallow
swallow.effect: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.

sweetKiss.name: Sweet Kiss
sweetKiss.effect: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

sweetScent.name: Sweet Scent
sweetScent.effect: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.

swift.name: Swift
swift.effect: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

switcheroo.name: Switcheroo
switcheroo.effect: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.

swordsDance.name: Swords Dance
swordsDance.effect: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user's Attack stat.

synchronoise.name: Synchronoise
synchronoise.effect: Using an odd shock wave, the user inflicts damage on any Pokémon of the same type in the area around it.

synthesis.name: Synthesis
synthesis.effect: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

syrupBomb.name: Syrup Bomb
syrupBomb.effect: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.

tachyonCutter.name: Tachyon Cutter
tachyonCutter.effect: The user attacks by launching particle blades at the target twice in a row. This attack never misses.

tackle.name: Tackle
tackle.effect: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

tailGlow.name: Tail Glow
tailGlow.effect: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

tailSlap.name: Tail Slap
tailSlap.effect: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. It hits the target two to five times in a row.

tailWhip.name: Tail Whip
tailWhip.effect: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stats.

tailwind.name: Tailwind
tailwind.effect: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that ups the Speed stats of the user and its allies for four turns.

takeDown.name: Take Down
takeDown.effect: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

takeHeart.name: Take Heart
takeHeart.effect: The user lifts its spirits, curing its own status conditions and boosting its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tarShot.name: Tar Shot
tarShot.effect: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

taunt.name: Taunt
taunt.effect: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

tearfulLook.name: Tearful Look
tearfulLook.effect: The user gets teary eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

teatime.name: Teatime
teatime.effect: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

technoBlast.name: Techno Blast
technoBlast.effect: The user fires a beam of light at its target. The move's type changes depending on the Drive the user holds.

tectonicRagePhysical.name: Tectonic Rage
tectonicRagePhysical.effect: The user burrows deep into the ground and slams into the target with the full force of its Z-Power. The power varies, depending on the original move.

teeterDance.name: Teeter Dance
teeterDance.effect: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
telekinesis.effect: The user makes the target float with its psychic power. The target is easier to hit for three turns.

teleport.name: Teleport
teleport.effect: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting, if any. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

temperFlare.name: Temper Flare
temperFlare.effect: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.

tenMillionVoltThunderbolt.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
tenMillionVoltThunderbolt.effect: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.

teraBlast.name: Tera Blast
teraBlast.effect: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat-whichever is higher for the user.

teraStarstorm.name: Tera Starstorm
teraStarstorm.effect: With the power of its crystals, the user bombards and eliminates the target. When used by Terapagos in its Stellar Form, this move damages all opposing Pokémon.

terrainPulse.name: Terrain Pulse
terrainPulse.effect: The user utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power changes depending on the terrain when it's used.

thief.name: Thief
thief.effect: The user attacks and has a 30% chance to steal the target's held item simultaneously.

thousandArrows.name: Thousand Arrows
thousandArrows.effect: This move also hits opposing Pokémon that are in the air. Those Pokémon are knocked down to the ground.

thousandWaves.name: Thousand Waves
thousandWaves.effect: The user attacks with a wave that crawls along the ground. Those it hits can't flee from battle.

thrash.name: Thrash
thrash.effect: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

throatChop.name: Throat Chop
throatChop.effect: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using moves that emit sound for two turns.

thunder.name: Thunder
thunder.effect: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderCage.name: Thunder Cage
thunderCage.effect: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

thunderFang.name: Thunder Fang
thunderFang.effect: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.

thunderPunch.name: Thunder Punch
thunderPunch.effect: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderShock.name: Thunder Shock
thunderShock.effect: A jolt of electricity crashes down on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderWave.name: Thunder Wave
thunderWave.effect: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.effect: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

thunderclap.name: Thunderclap
thunderclap.effect: This move enables the user to attack first with a jolt of electricity. This move fails if the target is not readying an attack.

thunderousKick.name: Thunderous Kick
thunderousKick.effect: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

tickle.name: Tickle
tickle.effect: The user tickles the target into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

tidyUp.name: Tidy Up
tidyUp.effect: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats.

topsyTurvy.name: Topsy-Turvy
topsyTurvy.effect: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.

torchSong.name: Torch Song
torchSong.effect: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.

torment.name: Torment
torment.effect: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

toxic.name: Toxic
toxic.effect: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

toxicSpikes.name: Toxic Spikes
toxicSpikes.effect: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.

toxicThread.name: Toxic Thread
toxicThread.effect: The user shoots poisonous threads to poison the target and lower the target's Speed stat.

trailblaze.name: Trailblaze
trailblaze.effect: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.

transform.name: Transform
transform.effect: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

triAttack.name: Tri Attack
triAttack.effect: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

trick.name: Trick
trick.effect: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

trickOrTreat.name: Trick-or-Treat
trickOrTreat.effect: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target's type.

trickRoom.name: Trick Room
trickRoom.effect: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.

tripleArrows.name: Triple Arrows
tripleArrows.effect: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target's Defense stat or make it flinch.

tripleAxel.name: Triple Axel
tripleAxel.effect: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

tripleDive.name: Triple Dive
tripleDive.effect: The user performs a perfectly timed triple dive, hitting the target with splashes of water three times in a row.

tripleKick.name: Triple Kick
tripleKick.effect: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

tropKick.name: Trop Kick
tropKick.effect: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.

trumpCard.name: Trump Card
trumpCard.effect: The fewer PP this move has, the greater its power.

twinBeam.name: Twin Beam
twinBeam.effect: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.

twineedle.name: Twineedle
twineedle.effect: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.

twinkleTacklePhysical.name: Twinkle Tackle
twinkleTacklePhysical.effect: The user creates a very charming space using its Z-Power and totally toys with the target. The power varies, depending on the original move.

twister.name: Twister
twister.effect: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

uTurn.name: U-turn
uTurn.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

upperHand.name: Upper Hand
upperHand.effect: The user reacts to the target's movement and strikes with the heel of its palm, making the target flinch. This move fails if the target is not readying a priority move.

uproar.name: Uproar
uproar.effect: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

vCreate.name: V-create
vCreate.effect: With a hot flame on its forehead, the user hurls itself at its target. This lowers the user's Defense, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.

vacuumWave.name: Vacuum Wave
vacuumWave.effect: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the target. This move always goes first.

veeveeVolley.name: Veevee Volley
veeveeVolley.effect: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move's power. It never misses.

venomDrench.name: Venom Drench
venomDrench.effect: Opposing Pokémon are drenched in an odd poisonous liquid. This lowers the Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats of a poisoned target.

venoshock.name: Venoshock
venoshock.effect: The user drenches the target in a special poisonous liquid. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned.

victoryDance.name: Victory Dance
victoryDance.effect: The user performs an intense dance to usher in victory, boosting its Attack, Defense, and Speed stats.

vineWhip.name: Vine Whip
vineWhip.effect: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

viseGrip.name: Vise Grip
viseGrip.effect: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

vitalThrow.name: Vital Throw
vitalThrow.effect: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

voltSwitch.name: Volt Switch
voltSwitch.effect: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

voltTackle.name: Volt Tackle
voltTackle.effect: The user electrifies itself and charges the target. This also damages the user quite a lot. This attack may leave the target with paralysis.

wakeUpSlap.name: Wake-Up Slap
wakeUpSlap.effect: This attack inflicts big damage on a sleeping target. This also wakes the target up, however.

waterGun.name: Water Gun
waterGun.effect: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

waterPledge.name: Water Pledge
waterPledge.effect: A column of water hits the target. When used with its fire equivalent, its power increases and a rainbow appears.

waterPulse.name: Water Pulse
waterPulse.effect: The user attacks the target with a pulsing blast of water. This may also confuse the target.

waterShuriken.name: Water Shuriken
waterShuriken.effect: The user hits the target with throwing stars two to five times in a row. This move always goes first.

waterSport.name: Water Sport
waterSport.effect: The user soaks the battlefield with water. This weakens Fire-type moves for five turns.

waterSpout.name: Water Spout
waterSpout.effect: The user spouts water to damage opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

waterfall.name: Waterfall
waterfall.effect: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

waveCrash.name: Wave Crash
waveCrash.effect: The user shrouds itself in water and slams into the target with its whole body to inflict damage. This also damages the user quite a lot.

weatherBall.name: Weather Ball
weatherBall.effect: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

whirlpool.name: Whirlpool
whirlpool.effect: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

whirlwind.name: Whirlwind
whirlwind.effect: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

wickedBlow.name: Wicked Blow
wickedBlow.effect: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

wickedTorque.name: Wicked Torque
wickedTorque.effect: The user revs their engine into the target with malicious intent. This may put the target to sleep.

wideGuard.name: Wide Guard
wideGuard.effect: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.

wildCharge.name: Wild Charge
wildCharge.effect: The user shrouds itself in electricity and smashes into its target. This also damages the user a little.

wildboltStorm.name: Wildbolt Storm
wildboltStorm.effect: The user summons a thunderous tempest and savagely attacks with lightning and wind. This may also leave opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

willOWisp.name: Will-O-Wisp
willOWisp.effect: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

wingAttack.name: Wing Attack
wingAttack.effect: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

wish.name: Wish
wish.effect: One turn after this move is used, the user's or its replacement's HP is restored by half the user's max HP.

withdraw.name: Withdraw
withdraw.effect: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

wonderRoom.name: Wonder Room
wonderRoom.effect: The user creates a bizarre area in which Pokémon's Defense and Sp. Def stats are swapped for five turns.

woodHammer.name: Wood Hammer
woodHammer.effect: The user slams its rugged body into the target to attack. This also damages the user quite a lot.

workUp.name: Work Up
workUp.effect: The user is roused, and its Attack and Sp. Atk stats increase.

worrySeed.name: Worry Seed
worrySeed.effect: A seed that causes worry is planted on the target. It prevents sleep by making the target's Ability Insomnia.

wrap.name: Wrap
wrap.effect: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

wringOut.name: Wring Out
wringOut.effect: The user powerfully wrings the target. The more HP the target has, the greater the move's power.

xScissor.name: X-Scissor
xScissor.effect: The user slashes at the target by crossing its scythes or claws as if they were a pair of scissors.

yawn.name: Yawn
yawn.effect: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

yuAbilityCrush.name: Ability Crush
yuAbilityCrush.effect: Contact. Ignores foe ability on hit. Suppresses foe ability. If user Atk has positive stage: +40 BP.

yuAbilitySurge.name: Ability Surge
yuAbilitySurge.effect: Power scales with ability procs this turn.

yuAbominableSlam.name: Abominable Slam
yuAbominableSlam.effect: Contact. Uses foe Attack stat. If foe is frozen: cannot miss.

yuAbsoluteBarrage.name: Absolute Barrage
yuAbsoluteBarrage.effect: Hits 3×. First hit: 30% paralysis. Second hit: 20% flinch. Third hit: 30% lowers foe Atk -1.

yuAbsoluteCataclysm.name: Absolute Cataclysm
yuAbsoluteCataclysm.effect: User takes 25% max HP recoil. Drains 33%. If user SpAtk has positive stage: drains 50% instead.

yuAbsoluteCharge.name: Absolute Charge
yuAbsoluteCharge.effect: If user Atk stage is +2 or higher: ignores abilities, Protect, AND type resistances.

yuAbsoluteChill.name: Absolute Chill
yuAbsoluteChill.effect: Lowers foe's Speed by 2 stages AND lowers their evasion by 1. If Hail or Snow is active: also removes foe's positive stat boosts.

yuAbsoluteThunder.name: Absolute Thunder
yuAbsoluteThunder.effect: If foe is paralyzed: ignores type resistances

yuAbsorbingTouch.name: Absorbing Touch
yuAbsorbingTouch.effect: Contact. Drains 33%. If user above 75% HP: drains 50% instead.

yuAbsorptionCataclysm.name: Absorption Cataclysm
yuAbsorptionCataclysm.effect: User loses 25% max HP. Drains 33%. If user has a Substitute: drains 50% instead.

yuAbsorptionPulse.name: Absorption Pulse
yuAbsorptionPulse.effect: Drains 40%. If foe is statused: drains 60%.

yuAbsorptionRecovery.name: Absorption Recovery
yuAbsorptionRecovery.effect: Heals 50%. Cures party status. If user has Substitute: heals 66% instead.

yuAbyssInitiative.name: Abyss Initiative
yuAbyssInitiative.effect: +1 priority. 10% flinch. If user has a positive stat stage: 35% flinch.

yuAbyssalInferno.name: Abyssal Inferno
yuAbyssalInferno.effect: User takes 25% max HP recoil. Drains 33%. If foe is burned: drains 50%.

yuAbyssalMandate.name: Abyssal Mandate
yuAbyssalMandate.effect: +1 SpAtk. If foe is burned: +2 SpAtk instead.

yuAbyssalPulse.name: Abyssal Pulse
yuAbyssalPulse.effect: Lowers foe SpDef -1. If foe SpDef has negative stage: lowers foe SpDef -2 instead.

yuAbyssalRecovery.name: Abyssal Recovery
yuAbyssalRecovery.effect: Heals 50%. Cures party status. If foe is burned: heals 66% instead.

yuAbyssalStrike.name: Abyssal Strike
yuAbyssalStrike.effect: Contact. 50% chance to lower foe Atk -1. If foe has a positive stat stage: lowers foe Atk -2.

yuAbyssalSurge.name: Abyssal Surge
yuAbyssalSurge.effect: 30% chance to lower foe SpDef -1. If foe trapped in Whirlpool: 50% chance to lower foe SpDef -1.

yuAbyssalTether.name: Abyssal Tether
yuAbyssalTether.effect: 30% chance to apply Whirlpool. If foe below 50% HP: 50% chance to apply Whirlpool.

yuAccumulatedMight.name: Accumulated Might
yuAccumulatedMight.effect: Gains +10 BP for each DIFFERENT stat that has been boosted at least once (max +50 at 5 different stats).

yuAcidFlask.name: Acid Flask
yuAcidFlask.effect: 30% poison. If foe is poisoned: 50% chance to suppress foe ability.

yuAcidFog.name: Acid Fog
yuAcidFog.effect: Lowers foe's SpDef -2. In rain - 30% chance to poison.

yuAcidLash.name: Acid Lash
yuAcidLash.effect: Contact. 50% chance to poison - If foe is trapped: this 100% Poison (guaranteed).

yuAcidTorrent.name: Acid Torrent
yuAcidTorrent.effect: 30% badly poison. If foe is poisoned: 30% chance to wrap foe.

yuAdaptiveCarapace.name: Adaptive Carapace
yuAdaptiveCarapace.effect: Changes user type to resist foe primary type. Heals 25%.

yuAdaptiveHex.name: Adaptive Hex
yuAdaptiveHex.effect: 30% chance to lowers SpDef -1. If already wrapped: instead 30% chance to lowers SpDef -2.

yuAdaptiveJaws.name: Adaptive Jaws
